data.name: Jumayyah
data.gender_notes: Jumayyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jumayyah is an Arabic name for girls that means 'beautiful', 'radiant'. It is derived from the word jamayil which means 'beauty'. The name Jumayyah carries the meaning “Beautiful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Jumayyah usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Beauty and radiance are seen as divine attributes in Islamic tradition. Naming a daughter Jumayyah is a way to remind her of these qualities and to encourage her to cultivate them in herself.
data.etymology: Jumayyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jumayyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: جمعية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث من أصل عربي بمعنى جمع وتربط
in_arabic.long_meaning: جمعية اسم عربي مؤنث، مشتق من الفعل جمع، وتعني جمع، وتربط، وربط، ويُستخدم في سياق جمع الأمور وربطها مع بعضها البعض. في السياق الإسلامي، قد يشير إلى توحيد المسلمين وربطهم بالله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: جمعیہ
in_urdu.meaning: جمع اور مربوط کرنے کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمعیہ ایک عربی اصطلاح ہے جو 'جمع' اور 'رابطہ' سے مشتق ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے جمع کرنا اور مربوط کرنا۔ اسے عربی سے لیا گیا ہے اور یہ عبادت گاہ میں ایک مقدس نام سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام کسی بھی چیز کو جمع کرنے اور ایک ساتھ رکھنے کی صلاحیت کا اظہار کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जुमैया
in_hindi.long_meaning: जुमैया एक अरबी मूल का नाम है, जो 'जुड़ाव' और 'संबंध' से सम्बंधित है। इसका अर्थ है एकत्रित करना और जोड़ना। इस्लामी परंपरा में यह नाम धार्मिक एकता और ईश्वर से जुड़ाव को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: جمايه
in_pashto.long_meaning: جمايه نوم پښتو کې د مجموګ ګڼې او ښه نښه په معنا دی. د اسلامي پرمختګ کې، د جمايه نوم د لويې او د خدای په ننګه ګډون په معنا دی.

in_english.name: Jumayyah
in_english.long_meaning: Jumayyah is an Arabic name of feminine origin, derived from the root word 'jamaa' which means 'gather', 'unite', and 'connect'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the gathering of Muslims and their unity with Allah. It signifies the act of bringing things together, forming bonds, and fostering a sense of community. The name is often associated with qualities such as togetherness, harmony, and spiritual connection.
